messages:
arjun: Kicking off a micro-launch for Quickstart prompts + starter tokens. Goal: drive 500 active users from webinar -> first 5 API calls.

maya: love it. timeline?

arjun: two-week runway. webinar next Wed. need posts, landing, and 3 nudge emails.

lucy: I'll own launch posts + copy. I suggest 3 post scaffolds: teaser, demo gif, CTA with 'starter_tokens'. I'll drop copy by EOD.

noah: I'll wire analytics and attribution. Need event names.

maya: event names: onboarding_started, first_prompt_run, used_starter_token. link to spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/seed-experiment

ben (growth): For A/B: Variant A = 50 tokens + quickstart template; Variant B = 100 tokens + live demo invite. split 50/50.

arjun: cool. Also routing: inbound leads from webinar signups should get immediate token grant + in-app nudge + 2-day email.

lucy: copy snippets: "Get 50 starter tokens to build with Redwood Inference"; social variant: "Try Redwood — 50 tokens on us."

analytics-bot: Created experiment EXP-2026-43, tracking ids set.

noah: sample routing rule:
```
if source == 'webinar' then grant('starter_tokens', 50);
email.delay('nudge_1', 48h)
```

maya: also need benchmark narrative for launch post — suggested KPIs: 7-day DAU, conversion to paid, median latency reported in dashboard.

ben (growth): hypothesis: starter tokens + curated prompt templates will increase first-week retention by 20%.

lucy: publishing schedule: social posts Mon/Wed/Fri, blog Wed, webinar Tue. will share assets.

arjun: ok assign: lucy(posts), noah(tracking), ben(variants + analysis), maya(webinar ops). deadline: assets Tue 12pm PT.

maya: noted. will send calendar invite.

ben (growth): can someone make a 1-liner for the webinar? "Build in minutes: ship an AI feature with Redwood starter tokens" feels clunky.

lucy: try: "Ship an AI feature in minutes — get starter tokens, ready prompts, and a live walkthrough." short version for social: "Ship AI features in minutes — join our live Quickstart workshop."

arjun: perfect. post copy approved.

noah: one more: set up cohort tag 'seed-webinar-2026-03' for segmentation.

analytics-bot: Cohort tag seed-webinar-2026-03 created.

maya: thanks. wrapping up — anyone blocked?

ben (growth): nope. I'll prep A/B dashboard.

lucy: will upload assets by 11:30.

arjun: sweet. check-in Tue 10am PT.

maya: done, invite sent :calendar:
